text:
Register Birth at US Embassy 🇺🇸🇮🇱
I (American) am on a A/5 visa, my husband is Israeli. I am trying to register our first child with the US Embassy, to get their citizenship, passport and SS. 

As a non-Israeli citizen, my  last name is not written on the Israeli Birth Certificate,  only my first name and middle name. Similarly, neither my husband or I have access to any of our child's documents online via gov.co.il portal because of my status. 

Did anyone else register their child with the US Embassy on  a B or A/5 visa? Would be grateful to know if you got your last name added to the Birth Certificate and if Misrad Hapnim was able to issue an English certificate at their office. Thanks!
